title: Infra sync with deliberately mergeable topics
description: Three tasks, each discussed in two separate places that the meeting explicitly merges into one item: certs come up at the start and again at the end (internal CA added), PDF export has two halves plus a demo GIF folded in, staging parity has a fix-now part and a monitoring part. The chair states the canonical count: three. Tests deduplication and respecting the meeting's own task boundaries.

expected_tasks.name: Renew SSL certificates and set up auto-renewal
key_points: wildcard cert for api.ourapp.com, deploy to load balancers
also rotate the internal CA cert for the service mesh in the same change window (expires two weeks after the public one)

expected_tasks.name: Build PDF export for reports
key_points: backend renders report to PDF with headless Chrome
frontend export button with a progress state for large reports
record a short demo GIF for the changelog as part of finishing

expected_tasks.name: Fix staging schema drift and add nightly parity check
key_points: staging is three migrations behind production
nightly job diffs staging schema vs production and posts to the infra channel on divergence

must_not_extract.topic: separate task for the internal CA cert rotation
must_not_extract.reason: explicitly folded into the SSL renewal task ('same task, same window')

must_not_extract.topic: separate task for the demo GIF
must_not_extract.reason: explicitly folded into the PDF export task ('fold it into your export task, not a separate item')

must_not_extract.topic: separate frontend and backend tasks for PDF export
must_not_extract.reason: explicitly one deliverable ('one task then'), one owner
